About Organization

The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) is a government organization responsible for recruiting staff for various government departments and ministries.

The SSC conducts various exams and recruitment processes to select eligible candidates for government jobs.

About the Programme

The SSC Combined Hindi Translators JHT Recruitment 2026 is a government job opportunity for candidates who want to work as translators in various government departments and ministries.

The programme aims to recruit eligible candidates for the post of Junior Hindi Translators, Junior Translation Officers, and Senior Hindi Translators.
